root_cause: Original autonomous-email composer rejects actions without source-specific evidence; source research can complete into canonical company-news and its original research action, but original composer never reads that completion before source preflight. Schedulers report internal success while provider-accepted email remains zero. The existing closure watchdog additionally marks a research-held prepared email expired after six hours; the generic email watchdog can retry source-held WAITING actions after twenty minutes without waiting for composer approval. This breaks the single action lineage.

observed_evidence.gmail_preflight: ok account/user resolved; no send implied

fix: Read original research_enrichment by its dedupe ID, then cross-check canonical company-news identity, timestamps, confidence and exact HTTPS source in existing composer. Re-run original quality gate. Preserve distinct recipient authority, suppression, idempotence, provider ACK/readback and outcome gates. Canonical closure now parks genuinely research-held originals as WAITING up to 48 hours and terminalizes without side effects if unresolved; original email watchdog excludes this hold from automatic requeue; original composer is sole owner of WAITING->PREPARED after full source and copy quality pass. The original commercial action closure emits a seven-day same-action handoff funnel and 30-day policy-scoped randomized experiment maturity in its existing bg_gezondheid record. Record first handoff error instead of only cron health. Attach a service-only read-only seven-day per-action observability view and aggregated scorecard to the existing email watchdog so every existing scheduler tick records handoff diagnostics; classify missing research/composer, expired source handoff, provider ACK/readback gaps, actual replies and realized revenue. Reuse the existing active CRO experiment policy and holdout, never invent uplift or recipients.
prevention_rule: No research action marked done, cron succeeded, positive model score or draft created is accepted as provider delivery. Research completeness requires verified source-to-original-action writeback; send requires provider acceptance/readback; causal learning requires valid sample/outcome design. A generic retry watchdog must never promote a source-held WAITING action; a closure watchdog must not expire a legitimate pending research action during its bounded evidence deadline. A learning result requires qualifying original action outcomes and evidence from both matured experiment arms; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_NOT_LEARNED. A successful cron tick can never override handoff-stage failures or low experiment power. Underpowered A/B remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and terminal claimed outcome requires exact external provider receipt.
terminal_rule: Required and CodeQL green, protected merge, deployed original Supabase composer, original blocked action re-evaluated against current company evidence, approved quality if eligible, then independent provider-ID/readback for any sent email; no forced send if source remains missing. Never mark GREEN with internal cron receipt alone. Verify wait transition and research+quality resume on the original action ID; canonical provider ID/readback and real outcomes required. Rejected research remains held and expires after 48h.
